subject: Re: Marketplace qualification — demo & technical milestones
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@gsi-ops.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: anjali@stratuscloud.com
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace discovery recap + suggested next milestones

Jonas / Camila —

Great to meet you both this morning. Quick recap from our side and a proposed cadence so we can move from discovery -> qualification -> joint demo: 

- What we heard: StratusCloud is evaluating marketplace-native solutions to reduce time-to-onboard for customers and to surface inference runtimes directly in their catalog. Key constraints: SSO via SAML, regional data residency (US west), and predictable latencies for demo workloads.
- Desired outcome: a partner-led technical demo that includes a short architecture review (20m), a 60m run-through of a representative inference job (load ~200 concurrent requests), and Q&A about integration with Stratus marketplace hooks.

Next proposals: 
1) Technical deep-dive (90m) — Red-team engineering + Stratus solution architect. We can host or you can lead via your sandbox.
2) Joint demo (60m) — customer-facing, partner-led, highlight marketplace install & SSO flow.

Available windows from our side next week: Tue 4/11 10:00-12:00 PT, Wed 4/12 13:00-15:00 PT, Thu 4/13 08:00-10:00 PT. Please suggest your preferred slot or share a calendar poll and we'll confirm.

Attachments: joint-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda + success criteria)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a date.

Tom Reynolds
Senior Solutions Director, GSI-Ops
Tom.Reynolds@gsi-ops.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@gsi-ops.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, anjali@stratuscloud.com
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace discovery recap + suggested next milestones

Tom —

Thanks for the clear recap and the proposed structure. We’re aligned on the agenda and success criteria. A few quick notes before we lock the slot: 

- For the technical deep-dive we prefer 90 minutes (architecture + live run + integration Q&A) and will bring one of our infra engineers and an SRE to answer latency/observability questions.
- On SSO/SAML: could you confirm whether Stratus prefers SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flows for the marketplace demo? That determines which auth flow we demo.
- For the live run, we’ll need a short dataset and a sample prompt set — can Stratus share a sanitzed sample or should we use our synthetic load profiles?

Our availability: Tue 4/11 10:00-11:30 PT (works), Wed 4/12 13:00-14:30 PT (works), Thu 4/13 morning preferable if nothing else fits. If you want a single confirmed slot now, I can block it and then introduce the demo owner.

On the SSO/residency questions above, tagging Camila to help coordinate on your side.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: none

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@gsi-ops.com>, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: anjali@stratuscloud.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace discovery recap + suggested next milestones (poll & intake)

Thanks Tom —

I created a short poll to pick the best slot and uploaded a brief intake form so we have the integration constraints captured ahead of the deep-dive. Please fill both out by EOD Monday so our engineering team can prep.

Links / attachments: 
- Calendar poll: https://cal.example.com/poll/3xQbZ
- Marketplace intake (please add SSO mode, sample payloads, and target regions): marketplace-intake-form.xlsx (attached)
- Drive folder with baseline test profile: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/marketplace-intake-1147

Quick notes: 
- We can run the live inference workload from our hosted sandbox or deploy a lightweight container in Stratus’s staging project — whichever you prefer. If Stratus wants us to bring their staging, include the service account and a temporary bucket in the intake form.
- For SSO: if Stratus uses IdP-initiated SAML, please include IdP metadata; for SP-initiated we’ll provide ACS/Entity IDs.

Ben Carter will own the demo on Redwood’s side — Ben, can you confirm you can lead the demo on 4/11 10:00-11:30 PT if that slot wins the poll?

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Partner Success Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: marketplace-intake-form.xlsx, calendar-poll.ics

All — thanks for coordinating. The Stratus team selected Tue 4/11 10:00-11:30 PT on the poll. That works for us.

Two quick confirmations: 
- Stratus will provide an IdP-initiated SAML metadata file (Anjali is looping in their security lead to send it).
- They prefer Redwood to host the live run via your hosted sandbox (simpler for the marketplace demo).

Jonas — assigning Ben as demo owner (cc'd). Ben, would you like me to add a short pre-demo alignment call (15m) on Mon 4/10 so engineering teams can agree on payload and run script?

If yes, propose Mon 4/10 11:00-11:15 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Tom Reynolds
Senior Solutions Director, GSI-Ops
Attachments: none
